headline: BEAMON LEAPS 29 FEET 2½ INCHES
dispatch: Bob Beamon of the United States yesterday soared 29 feet 2½ inches in the Olympic long jump at Mexico City. The leap, measured at 8.90 metres, broke the world record by nearly two feet and gave the Americans another track and field gold medal.
answer: Bob Beamon sets long-jump world record, 1968
